summary: Self-check failures on two creature sheets. Both are kept because the user's auto-retry budget is 0; the user decides at H2 whether to regenerate one image each.

findings.issue: The Gryphon's foreparts are carried upright like a perched eagle rather than on a level, lion-like body. The side-profile panel is cropped at mid-body, so the lion hindquarters, hind legs and tail do not show in profile.

The Mock Turtle stands upright on its two hind calf legs, with its flippers hanging like arms and the shell worn like a pack, and the neck is elongated. The card describes a turtle-shell body resting low, with the calf head rising from the front of the shell. The calf head, tears, flippers, hooves and shell texture are all correct.

suggested_fix_if_regenerated: One targeted image each, with no candidate race. CRE-005: describe a lion body with a horizontal spine, and have the side panel show the full body length, nose to tail. CRE-006: describe a sea turtle resting belly-low on the ground, with the calf head at shell height and both hind hooves tucked beside the rear of the shell; add 'standing upright, bipedal' to the negative prompt.
waiver_note: User signed PASS_WITH_WAIVER (approval ba96732d, 2026-09-23). Auto-retry/re-roll budget is 0, so neither assets/concepts/creatures/CRE-005/sheet.png nor CRE-006/sheet.png was regenerated; this defect stays OPEN as a waived major, not a blocker for storyboarding (runs/g4/gate.json 'effect'). bible/creatures/creature.json CRE-005/CRE-006 text cards were left unchanged by 04-creatures/creature (p4-h2-creature) — the cards already describe the correct anatomy (level lion body, low-resting turtle-shell body); only the two sheet images diverge from the cards.

corrective_wording_for_future_use.purpose: This is the wording 08-video-gen/prompt must inline (verbatim or in close paraphrase) whenever the Gryphon (CRE-005) or the Mock Turtle (CRE-006) appears in a generation-group prompt, per runs/g4/gate.json waiver follow_up, until an explicit user-ordered re-roll fixes the sheets themselves.
corrective_wording_for_future_use.CRE-005_gryphon: Quadruped, crouched-to-standing Gryphon: a level, lion-like body carried on a horizontal spine (not perched upright like an eagle); eagle head, neck, wings and forelegs at the front grading into lion hindquarters, hind legs and long tufted tail at the back. If a profile/side view is framed, keep the full body length in frame, nose to tail — do not crop at mid-body.
corrective_wording_for_future_use.CRE-006_mock_turtle: Mock Turtle rests on all four legs / belly-low on the ground, turtle-shell body close to the surface, with the calf head and neck rising from the front of the shell at roughly shell height — not standing upright on its two hind legs. Both hind hooves stay tucked beside the rear of the shell; flippers stay at the front, functioning as forelimbs, not hanging like arms. Negative prompt should include 'standing upright, bipedal, elongated neck'.
